title: AI couldn't draw a full glass of wine 🍷

beats.big:
Draw a FULL
glass of
wine.
beats.say: For years, AI could not draw a full glass of wine.
Ask for a glass filled to the brim, and DALL-E, Imagen, Grok and Flux all poured you half a glass.
You could beg. Still half full.

beats.big:
Think of
every wine
photo ever.
beats.say: The likely reason? Think of every wine photo ever posted.

beats.big:
Nobody
pours it
to the top.
beats.sub: so the AI almost never saw one
beats.say: Nobody pours wine to the top. So the AI almost never saw a full glass.

beats.sub: it remixes pictures it has seen
beats.say: It doesn't know what full means. It just remixes pictures it has seen.
It took until March twenty twenty five for OpenAI's new image model to finally fill it up.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
